Supply credentials of private organisations will n ot be considered. Firms must attach Contract/Purchase order copies along with CRAC, Receipt not e, RITES inspection certificate or completion certificate or else the offers will be rejected. 4.5) Details of previous supplies to various hospitals in Railways, other Government hospitals with year of sale and contact person to be enclosed. Performance report from these institutions should be enclosed which can be verified after tender opening. 4.6) Copies of all certificates, licenses, approvals and test reports mentioned as available against t he offered product's technical specification parameter values shall be submitted along with the off er for evaluation and verification by the purchaser.

4.7) Product Details: The bidder shall clearly indicate the OEM/manufacturer name, model/part nu mber, brand, country of origin and applicable technical literature/datasheet for the offered product . The offered model shall be clearly identifiable from the submitted documents. 4.8) Should be able to demonstrate the model offered when called for by the Administration befor e finalization of the tender (On line mode or off line mode). 4.9) Bidders who are Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) must give an undertaking for suppl y of spare parts for the period of the expected life of the equipment. Other Bidders must submit u ndertaking from OEM for supply of spares for the expected life of the equipment (Format enclosed as below). 4.10) The firm shall have a service facility in South India with spare parts readily available in Palak kad, and shall ensure availability of service and required spare parts within 24 hours of receipt of the service request.

4.11) After sales service required at the place of delivery. Details of after sales service facilities lik e address, e-mail etc, contact details of technicians with name & mobile number, Engineer with th eir qualification, inventory for repair and number of equipment serviced by Centre should be enclo sed. 4.12) Original Product instruction manual, service manual, trouble shooting guide should be enclos ed 4.13) Warranty : 3 years Onsite Comprehensive Warranty. 4.14) Post warranty CAMC is required for 5 years - Bidder shall quote the CAMC rates in the separa te sheet. 4.15) Technical compliance: a) The specifications mentioned are the minimum standards required by us and anything better w ould be acceptable. b) 1) In case of any deviation to technical specification, should be clearly indicated in the offer. 2) Railway reserves the right either to consider or not to consider offered deviations based on end user requirement. 4.16) Product Performance: a) Railway reserves the right to accept/reject the offer based on past performance to ensure reliab ility of supply and quality of the offered product. b) One of the essential principles of purchasing function is selection of right source for supply. Thi s aspect has been emphasized by Railway Board through various circulars in the past RB Lr No. 20 22/RS(G)777/1(E 3382862) New Delhi dated 07.07.2022 with Sub: Acceptance of tender, Consider ation of performance of vendors. Railway Board letter dated 11.02.2016 inter-alia stipulates due c onsideration of dis-satisfactory past performance of vendors while deciding tender to ensure timel y supply of material in required quantity to meet the needs of operation, maintenance, safety, etc. of the Railways. With complete digitization of the supply chain, sufficient data is available on IREP S/IMMS reflecting various aspects of performance of suppliers for individual contract, supplier and item.

Warranty failures and response of vendors to such failures is one of the important parameters of p erformance of a vendor. Suitable means may be adopted to capture warranty performance of the vendors. It is again emphasized that Performance of vendors, including warranty failures and resp onse, would invariably be considered while deciding the tenders. Rejection / Replacement: Goods found defective or not conforming to the specifications during ins pection or after receipt at destination shall be replaced/repaired by the Seller at its own cost, inclu ding applicable transportation/freight charges, within the period specified by the Purchaser. Such r eplacement shall not affect the Seller's other contractual obligations. 4.17) Security Deposits : 5% of Contract Value is applicable after award of contract and additional 5% of Contract Value at the time of bill passing. Both securities will be released after the completi on of all warranty obligations. 4.18) CAMC : a) Should quote separately for 05 years CAMC charges after completion of the warranty period. Sc ope of work, Type of preventive schedule, Periodicity, Items to be checked/replaced should be quo ted as below mentioned table. Type of Preventi Expected plan Items to be Items of ve t Sl. No. Periodicity checked replacement schedule downtime If any of the spares/items not covered under CAMC should be clearly mentioned. b) The CAMC shall necessarily include minimum of 2 preventive visits and any number of breakdo wn calls. c) Inter-se position of offers shall be determined based on the evaluated cost comprising the cost of the equipment and the Net Present Value (NPV) of the Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Con tract (CAMC) for a period of five years following the free comprehensive warranty period. Firms sh all quote the actual CAMC rates in their bids. The system will automatically calculate the NPV of th e quoted CAMC charges for the purpose of financial evaluation and determination of the inter-se r anking only. The NPV calculation is solely for evaluation purposes and shall not affect the actual C AMC charges payable under the contract. d) Railway reserves the right through consignee officer whether to enter into CAMC contract or not

as per the accepted rate schedules. Firm is contractually bound to provide CAMC services if consig nee enters into CAMC contract. e) Consignee reserves the right to cancel the CAMC contract by forfeiting the CAMC Security or by recovering applicable penalty charges in case of non-performance/default in fulfilling CAMC obliga tions as per terms & conditions of the contract. f) Payment of CAMC charges will, however, be as per actual annual CAMC charges accepted in the contract. Any delay after 48 hours without providing stand by facilities shall attract a penalty of 1% per day of CAMC annual value. 4.19) Successful bidder should upload Turnover Declaration Certificate as per the Railways Perfor ma and GST Tax Invoice along with the GeM Invoice in order to make the payment.
